headline: The new Fitbit Edge leaks
summary: Successor to the Charge line, the Fitbit Edge has leaked. New images posted by Android Headlines show the device. It appears to split the difference between the Pixel Watch and other trackers.

headline: Prick's theatrical industrial punk is perfect for spooky season
summary: Trent Reznor lent production talents to Prick's debut album. Reznor is credited on four tracks, leaving his distinct mark. The album's industrial glam punk sound is ideal for spooky season.

headline: The best early October Prime Day deals happening now
summary: Amazon is offering early Prime Big Deal Day discounts. Deals include Amazon's own hardware and popular products. October Prime Day officially starts October 6th and runs through the 8th.

headline: NJ's former Lt Gov is using AI to say he's innocent of sexual harassment
summary: Former NJ Lt. Governor Dale Caldwell resigned after sexual harassment allegations. Caldwell is attempting to clear his name through media appearances. He used AI during an interview to claim innocence.

headline: Blindfolded Tekken 8 Player Achieves One of the Game's Top Ranks from Beginner
summary: Professional Tekken 8 player SuperBrine has gone viral. He reached the 'God of Destruction' rank using Alisa. This impressive feat was achieved while completely blindfolded.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Star Wars Zero Company, AirPods Pro 3, Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter, and More
summary: Discover today's top gaming and tech deals. Featured offers include Star Wars Zero Company and AirPods Pro 3. Find discounts on Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter and other popular products.

headline: Blade Director Defends 'Good Dude' Kevin Feige After Marvel Scrapped Mahershala Ali's 1920s Vampire Movie
summary: Blade director Bassam Tariq felt like a 'failure' after exiting the film. He defended Kevin Feige, not blaming him for project issues. Marvel had scrapped Mahershala Ali's original 1920s vampire movie concept.

headline: James Gunn Shuts Down Jensen Ackles Batman Casting Rumors
summary: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn addressed recent speculation. He explicitly shut down rumors about Jensen Ackles. Ackles was rumored to be cast as the DCU's Batman.

headline: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
summary: All US bombers deployed to RAF Fairford have been removed. They have been re-deployed to their home stations. This move signifies the return of the bombers to the US.

headline: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
summary: Brazil's election will proceed to a run-off vote. Neither candidate secured over 50% in the initial round. Right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round.

headline: Green Party members back 'Zionism is racism' motion
summary: Green Party members supported a motion declaring 'Zionism is racism'. The vote occurred during their conference in Brighton. This decision has caused divisions within the party's leadership.

headline: I'm a classic old school Conservative, says Kemi Badenoch
summary: Tory leader Kemi Badenoch identifies as a 'classic old school Conservative'. She aims to echo the guiding political principles of Margaret Thatcher. Badenoch is outlining her conservative philosophy.
